name: parlisense
description: ParliSense Monorepo - Frontend and Backend are hosted and run independently.

scripts.dev: echo "[NOTICE] Do not trigger servers from the root folder. Run 'cd frontend && npm run dev' for the frontend server, or 'cd backend && npm run dev' for the backend server."
scripts.build: echo "[NOTICE] Run 'cd frontend && npm run build' or 'cd backend && npm run build' in their respective directories."
